_doc: The one box table for the 3 branches (F-15): lon_min, lat_min, lon_max, lat_max. Read by infra/data/s8/run.sh (the 3 map cuts), infra/data/s8/streets.py (the street source) and infra/data/p2-streets/build.py (the branch areas of the street list). Columbus is the R5 line 38 map box (docs/planning/round-1/research/R5-maps-hosting.md). The key order is the tie-break order.
